title: Trunk Area Noise and Miscellaneous Area Mentions
summary: This topic is loosely clustered around trunk or rear-area comments, with a few clear complaints about trunk-area noise and many fragments that are too vague or unrelated to support a single consistent theme.

positive.summary: One positive review describes a trunk or rear-area buzzing and air-release sound without expressing dissatisfaction.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on dissatisfaction with the trunk area and rattling noise from the rear sun curtain in the trunk area.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention areas, storage, hangers, phone detection, or learning controls, but they are too brief or unrelated to assign a clear sentiment.

limitations: The cluster mixes trunk-area complaints with unrelated or highly vague area-based fragments, so it does not form a fully coherent single subject.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in summarizing detailed customer sentiment beyond the explicit trunk-area complaints.
Some fragments are too short or context-poor to identify the underlying feature or issue precisely.
